description: V2 eligibility state for CR2032. Conservatively calculated. All gates must be explicitly satisfied before any value is elevated. publicEligibility must remain false until all required gates pass.

eligibilityState.technicalIdentityEligibilityReason: Canonical designation, nominal voltage, diameter, height, and broad lithium classification are present as candidate values from manufacturer sources. Corroboration is incomplete (Panasonic-only for primary status). No field has cleared source rights. Cannot advance beyond partially_validated.
eligibilityState.safetyContentEligibilityReason: Regulatory context sources (ACCC overview) are present as candidates but rights have not been reviewed. Hazard context identified but not cleared for public display. Held at under_review.
eligibilityState.stewardshipContentEligibilityReason: No stewardship evidence (recycling, disposal, end-of-life guidance) has been sourced. No sources with cleared rights for stewardship content. Remains at no_evidence.
eligibilityState.compatibilityStatusReason: No compatibility or equivalence assessment has been performed. No inference from source omission. Compatibility remains not_assessed.
eligibilityState.publicEligibilityReason: publicEligibility requires all required gates to be explicitly satisfied. At minimum, technicalIdentityEligibility must reach reviewed or approved, and source rights must be cleared. Current state: technically partially_validated, safety under_review, stewardship no_evidence, compatibility not_assessed. publicEligibility cannot be true.

compatibilityStatus.note: Must remain not_assessed. No compatibility assessment permitted in Sprint 1.
